title: THE ENQUIRY
author: Rohit Dash
text:
They enquired
Soon after my birth
From where I came
Me told
From mother`s womb
They asked again
Where shall I go
I answered
To my epitaphic tomb.
I started my journey
my way
But throughout
I was queried
About my name
My dynasty
My surname
My caste
My creed
My religion
My belief
I had only one
Answer for them
I am a man a Human.
But it was not enough
For them.
I told leave me alone
Let me live my life
My way
Please stay away
But they never listened.
They always wanted
To confine me or hold
in a street
In house
In a town
In a state
In a country
In a world
In an universe
But no one listened
What I told.

I belong to the cosmos
I am a cosmic man
Defiant they were
Who still continued
Giving me strain
They had only
One intention
To give pain
To impose rules
And to reign.
stanzas: I am a man a Human.
